trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Customer states their issue and expresses urgency.
steps.text: नमस्कार, माझा order कुठे आहे? मला तो आजच हवा आहे. I am in a rush.

steps.purpose: Agent greets and asks for the order ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी नक्की मदत करेन. तुमचा order ID सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Customer provides the order ID.
steps.text: हो, तो ORD-30003 आहे. लवकर चेक करा.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the details of the order.
Return the order details and status.
Agent provides the order status based on the tool result.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमची running shoes ची order out for delivery आहे. ही prepaid order आहे.

steps.purpose: Customer asks for tracking details using English domain terms.
steps.text: मग आज मिळेल का? माझ्याकडे वेळ नाही, लवकर track करून सांगा.

steps.purpose: Fetch the courier tracking details.
Return the tracking scan history.
Agent relays the tracking information without switching to English.
steps.text: तुमची shipment BlueDart कडून येत आहे. Last scan नुसार ते 'Out for delivery' आहे आणि कोणतीही अडचण नाही.

steps.purpose: Customer demands a guarantee or wants to raise a complaint.
steps.text: पण मला guarantee हवी आहे की आजच मिळेल. नाहीतर complaint raise करा.

steps.purpose: Agent refuses to guarantee delivery and explains the promised window.
steps.text: माफ करा, पण मी आजच्या delivery ची guarantee देऊ शकत नाही. Order २ दिवसांपूर्वी केली होती आणि promised time ४ दिवसांचा आहे.

steps.purpose: Customer expresses frustration about the delay and asks for confirmation.
steps.text: म्हणजे अजून २ दिवस लागू शकतात? I have a meeting, लवकर सांगा.

steps.purpose: Agent denies the complaint request as the window is still active.
steps.text: होय, promised window अजून संपलेली नाही. त्यामुळे आता complaint raise करता येणार नाही.

steps.purpose: Customer asks for the tracking number.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. मला AWB number द्या, मी स्वतः track करतो.

steps.purpose: Agent prompts for identity verification before sharing the AWB.
steps.text: AWB number देण्यापूर्वी, मला तुमची identity verify करावी लागेल. तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Customer provides their pincode with an STT error.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return verification success.
Agent shares the AWB number after verification.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमचा AWB number BD123456 आहे. तुम्ही BlueDart च्या वेबसाईटवर track करू शकता.

steps.purpose: Customer asks about refund options if delivery fails.
steps.text: Okay, चालते. जर नाही आला तर refund मिळेल का?

steps.purpose: Agent explains the next steps without making unsupported refund guarantees.
steps.text: जर ४ दिवसांच्या promised window मध्ये delivery नाही झाली, तर आपण complaint raise करू शकतो. त्यानंतरच पुढील माहिती देता येईल.

steps.purpose: Customer accepts the resolution and ends the conversation.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.

variant_findings.reason: The customer frequently uses English domain terms ('guarantee', 'complaint raise', 'meeting', etc.) within Marathi sentences. The agent successfully maintains Marathi as the primary language while incorporating the English terms, without switching entirely to English.

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds all their claims in the tool outputs (e.g., citing the 4-day promised window and 2 days since order) and explicitly refuses to make unsupported forward guarantees about today's delivery or refunds.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: Both the user and the agent speak using raw snake_case JSON keys and tool names. The user asks the agent to 'track_shipment' (e7), revealing knowledge of the backend tool. The agent uses raw schema keys like 'out_for_delivery' (e6), 'last_scan' (e10), 'promised_days' (e12), and 'registered_pincode' (e16). This is highly unnatural.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the conversation from e6 onwards. Convert all snake_case variables and tool names into natural language (e.g., 'out for delivery', 'track the order', 'last scan', 'promised days', 'registered pincode').

issues.detail: The IR step s17 dictates that the customer provides their pincode with an STT error, but the generated text ('माझा pincode 411001 आहे. लवकर करा.') is perfectly transcribed with no STT artifacts.
issues.repair_instruction: Introduce a plausible STT transcription error for the pincode in the user's utterance.
